event.delta: This looks like an expense tracker: a header with a total, an add-expense form, a list and a chart.
The top row has a text box, a small box labelled "$", a dropdown arrow and a button that says "Add".
Below it, stacked rows with a little x on the right of each, so every expense can be removed.
The circle on the right with slices must be a doughnut chart of spending by category. I'll use Chart.js for it and keep it in sync with the list.
There's a squiggle labelled "budget" under the title, so I'll add a monthly budget with a progress bar and the amount left.
Plan: warm palette, a few realistic expenses to start with, category filter chips, state in memory. Markup first, one script at the end.
